15111.name: Mad Servant
notes: ZG walks 15-17: the Servant packs at steps 88-97 ended 4 of the 6 raids that reached them, 19-23 dead at the pull; killing a Servant opens its Portal of Madness (24621) on death, and that portal (15141) is where the Voidwalkers come from.

15146.name: Mad Voidwalker
notes: Shadow Shock is an instant 15 yd pulse around it that no kick stops; the Voidwalkers arrive through a Servant's Portal of Madness.

11368.name: Bloodseeker Bat
notes: Charges in on aggro (creature_template spell slot 24023, cast by the generic_spell_ai script); it is also Jeklik's summon add, and the Bat and Bat Rider packs cost about 155 deaths over ZG walks 12-17.

14750.name: Gurubashi Bat Rider
notes: ZG walks 12-17: 2 wipes and about 6 near wipes. Unstable Concoction (24024) is the rider's own bomb: below 40 % hp it blows itself up, 10 yd around it, 3 s cast, cannot be kicked; it also shouts Demoralizing Shout on aggro and buffs nearby allies with Battle Command.

10470.name: Scholomance Neophyte
notes: Scholomance leg 0-2: the caster packs caused about 95 wipes over 10 runs and stopped 3 runs; both listed casts are kickable. Fear 12542 sits in its template spell slots but is never cast.

10471.name: Scholomance Acolyte
notes: Dark Mending is a kickable heal, so the Acolyte dies first; it also mana burns and opens with Shadowform.

10499.name: Spectral Researcher
notes: Wail of Souls is an instant 30 yd AoE with a knockback and a mana drain, so no kick stops it.

10469.name: Scholomance Adept
notes: Cone of Cold is a 10 yd frontal cone on a 10 s cooldown; the Adept flees at 15% hp.

10477.name: Scholomance Necromancer
notes: Shadow Bolt Volley is a kickable 30 yd AoE; Corpse Explosion comes on a kill and Call of the Grave at 30% hp.

10476.name: Scholomance Necrolyte
notes: Shadow Barrier shields a friend; the Necrolyte is the pack's other caster.

60597.name: Maddened Vault Guard
notes: Stormwind Vault first pull: about 14 wipes, and one run stopped at the third step after 12 wipes and 60 deaths; a later step 8 pull still brought 3-4 guards at once. Knock Away throws a bot out of the group.

60596.name: Runic Construct
notes: The other half of that first pull: a kickable Arcane Bolt and an interruptible Arcane Explosion, so the construct goes down first.

5648.name: Sandfury Shadowcaster
notes: Antu'sul camp (steps 22-30): about 13 wipes and 3 runs stopped. Shadow Bolt is kickable, Demon Skin is its opening self-buff, and it runs at 15% hp.

5650.name: Sandfury Witch Doctor
notes: The camp's healer: a kickable Flash Heal and a Healing Ward (8179) that heals on; killing the ward makes it drop a Lava Spout Totem (6017). It runs at 15% hp.

7246.name: Sandfury Shadowhunter
notes: Patrols with the Velratha blood-drinker group. Hex turns a bot into a critter, so it stops fighting; the hunter runs at 15% hp.

7247.name: Sandfury Soul Eater
notes: Heals its group with Dark Offering every 11-16 s and drains with a kickable Soul Bite; it runs at 15% hp.

5649.name: Sandfury Blood Drinker
notes: Velratha group: about 6 wipes, 3 of them in 6 runs. Blood Leech is an instant 10 yd drain - 78 of the 94 hits in one wipe - so no kick stops it, and the group runs at 10-13% hp.

11471.name: Eldreth Apparition
notes: Dire Maul West Eldreth hall (steps 128 and 147): about 11 wipes, five of them in a row at step 147. Frostbolt is kickable, Chains of Ice roots a bot where it stands, and it opens with Frost Armor.

11472.name: Eldreth Spirit
notes: Banshee Shriek silences everyone around it and no kick stops it; Ribbon of Souls hits the whole group. Part of the Eldreth hall's ~11 wipes.

11475.name: Eldreth Phantasm
notes: Shrink is a kickable cast that shrinks a bot and cuts its stats; Call of the Grave is an instant 5 yd disease pulse every 15-20 s.

11484.name: Residual Monstrosity
notes: Immol'thar hall: about 9 wipes, two of them at steps 441/442 and stopping a run there. Arcane Bolt is kickable, Arcane Blast is an instant 10 yd knockback no kick stops every 3.8-5.2 s, and on death it summons Mana Bursts (14397).

5263.name: Mummified Atal'ai
notes: Jammal'an corridor (steps 897-915): about 11 wipes. Its Fevered Plague is a disease DoT on the tank.

5271.name: Atal'ai Deathwalker
notes: Fear is kickable and it is what the corridor punishes; on death it summons its Deathwalker's Spirit (8317) into the fight.

5273.name: Atal'ai High Priest
notes: Both heals are kickable, so the High Priest dies first; it summons an Atal'ai Skeleton (8324), shields itself below 30% hp and runs at 15% hp.

4809.name: Twilight Acolyte
notes: Kelris platform and hall (steps 554-584): about 6 wipes and 3 runs stopped. Its Renew is kickable, so the Acolyte dies first; it runs at 15% hp.

4810.name: Twilight Reaver
notes: Arcing Smash is a frontal cone on everything in front of it; the Reaver runs at 15% hp.

4811.name: Twilight Aquamancer
notes: Summons an Aqua Guardian as it spawns; Frostbolt is kickable and it runs at 15% hp.

4812.name: Twilight Loreseeker
notes: Slows a bot with no cast to kick and grows itself below 30% hp; the least dangerous of the casters on the platform.

4813.name: Twilight Shadowmage
notes: Dominate Mind is a kickable cast that charms a bot into fighting its own group; it summons a Voidwalker (8996) as it spawns.

4814.name: Twilight Elementalist
notes: Every shock it casts is instant, so no kick stops any of them; four damage schools on the same pull. It runs at 15% hp.
